claim: Free Software Media System; alternative to Emby and Plex; descended from Emby 3.5.2; no premium licenses or features
Install guide: Windows, macOS, Debian/Ubuntu, other Linux, Docker/Kubernetes/Podman, Synology, TrueNAS SCALE; FreeBSD and TrueNAS CORE not supported because of .NET
Server hosts the web client by default; ffmpeg required (jellyfin-ffmpeg); .NET SDK for building
Hardware acceleration methods: QSV, NVENC, AMF, VA-API, VideoToolbox, RKMPP; partial acceleration raises CPU usage and lowers speed
Networking is covered in the post-install docs (administrator task)
